entries.alt: Four fictional adult women sit closely together on a terrace at Yerevan's Cascade, one resting against another while two lean in, wearing short blue, ivory, red-navy and Armenia-tricolor looks with rainbow knee-highs and metallic heels; distant fictional smoke rises over the city.

Four fictional adult women share a staggered seated pose beside Garni Gorge's basalt columns, wearing short copper, gold, teal and plum outfits with rainbow pumps, black platforms and tall green boots; subtle RAZE details appear on clothing and shoes.

Four fictional adult women hug and reach toward one another on a Lake Sevan terrace, wearing short crimson, gold, red-blue-orange and green outfits with rainbow knee-highs, black RAZE boots and green pumps; fictional fires and smoke rise on distant hills.

Four fictional adult women share a close back hug and linked-hand pose in a lantern-lit Dilijan courtyard, wearing short Armenia-tricolor, red-blue-orange, teal and green-plum outfits with silver RAZE boots, black pumps and rainbow platforms; visible rose, heart, skull-column, crescent and GRD tattoos appear on their arms.
